answer: Each agent must lock collateral at one trust-graph vertex and earn an attestation from a distinct, already-staked peer before it can vote. Reputation is eigenvector centrality, so a farm of fakes only attests to itself and stays a faint nebula on the fringe, never bending honest influence the way a prism bends light. The attacker pays one bond plus one genuine endorsement per fake, so N votes cost N bonds and N real attestations.
